text:
maria: Silverline reporting repeated 503s on embeddings route for the last 2 hours. CS flagged as potential SLA breach (p99 tail). Can we triage? @alex @teju

alex: looking. can you paste a sample request id / timeframe?

maria: timeframe ~14:12-14:40 UTC. sample req ids: req_9843, req_9849. pasted truncated log: ```gpu_queue_timeout -> 503; latency p99: 3.9s```

maria: customer is on Dedicated Bronze pool (pool-id: db-17). they want an ETA.

teju: oncall alerted, checking autoscale events & pool saturation. @li can runtime confirm if this looks like KV cache thrash?

li: not KV. I see continuous batching spikes + OOM retries on worker node g3-12. One host restarted at 14:25. suspect kernel crash from quantized op. grabbing logs now.

alex: if it's worker crash, fallback should route to host pool-secondary. did routing fallback trigger?

teju: fallback didn't because pool-secondary capacity was exhausted. autoscaler didn't spin up due to pending preemptible quotas. escalating to infra to free capacity. cc @dave (product) — Silverline is high-touch on Bronze plan.

dave: noted. We need a short commitment. what's the minimum fix we can do in the next 4h? options: patch, routing override, or capacity bump.

li: fastest = temporary routing override to warm-standby-2 + revert model quantization to v1 for the affected model. work: 1) runtime revert (li) ~30m, 2) routing override (alex) ~15m, 3) customer comms (maria) after completion.

alex: I can do the routing override. it's a config flip, no code review. I'll queue it and monitor. pinging infra to free standby.

teju: I'll coordinate autoscaler and confirm preemptible availability. also plan to apply a soft rate-limit to the customer if needed to protect p99.

maria: please ping me with "ready" so I can update Silverline. they asked for ETA <1h or they'll escalate to GSS.

deploy-bot: deploy request accepted — override-route to warm-standby-2 queued by alex. CID: dr-5521.

alex: override applied. watching p99. initial numbers look better: p99 down to ~1.2s. continuing to monitor for 20m.

li: submitted runtime revert to quantization v1 for model x-embed-s4. staged, no code review needed. patch finishing in ~12m.

teju: infra freed one host; autoscaler now able to add capacity. no restarts in last 6m.

maria: Silverline notified: temporary routing override + runtime revert applied, they see improvement. thanks team. keeping thread open until EOD for RCA and credits.

alex: follow-ups: 1) postmortem owner = alex; 2) RCA doc + kernel stack = li; 3) routing policy change to avoid single-standby exhaustion = teju. I'll create tickets and link here.

dave: include credit calc + SLA impact in postmortem. ping me to review before sending to CS.

maria: thanks — primary owners are alex, li, teju. i'll update Silverline once tickets + postmortem draft ready.

maria: (keeping thread open) last_message_ts 2881234867
